# ProjectRead

`schemas/api/project.json`

One record of GET /v1/projects (docs/design/m0/07; M1 slice plan P1): a registered project, its adopted profile revision and that revision's content digest. Never the profile itself: its repository URL may carry a credential.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `name` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `200`) |  |
| `revision` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `1000000`) | The adopted profile revision; 1 is the profile project.create registered. |
| `profile_digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The adopted revision's content digest (RFC 8785). |
| `created_by` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `created_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
